raw_message.reasoning:
The file imports everything from itertoolz, functoolz, dicttoolz, recipes, and compatibility.map/filter, etc. So to expose new symbols we need to add them to the relevant module's __all__ and they will be automatically exported.

But note that toolz/__init__.py only imports * from each module, so any symbol added to __all__ in those modules will be available.

Now let's examine dicttoolz.py to see merge and merge_with definitions.
